message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of some of the most celebrated American composers—spanning classical, jazz, and contemporary genres:

| Composer | Era / Style | Notable Works |
|----------|-------------|---------------|
| **John Philip Sousa** (1854‑1932) | “March King” | *The Stars and Stripes Forever*, *Semper Fidelis* |
| **Scott Joplin** (1868‑1917) | Ragtime | *Maple Leaf Rag*, *The Entertainer* |
| **George Gershwin** (1898‑1937) | Jazz‑Classical Fusion | *Rhapsody in Blue*, *Porgy & Bess* |
| **Duke Ellington** (1899‑1974) | Jazz | *Mood Indigo*, *Take the A Train* |
| **Aaron Copland** (1900‑1990) | Modern Classical | *Appalachian Spring*, *Fanfare for the Common Man* |
| **Leonard Bernstein** (1918‑1990) | Broadway & Classical | *West Side Story*, *Candide* |
| **Philip Glass** (born 1937) | Minimalism | *Einstein on the Beach*, *Glassworks* |
| **John Adams** (born 1947) | Contemporary Classical | *Nixon in China*, *Short Ride in a Fast Machine* |
| **Steve Reich** (born 1936) | Minimalism | *Music for 18 Musicians*, *Different Trains* |
| **John Williams** (born 1950) | Film Scores | *Star Wars*, *Indiana Jones*, *Jurassic Park* |

These figures have shaped not only American music but also had a lasting global influence.
